messages:
Evan R.: Ran profiling on the 4xA100 inference job — seeing ~1.3GB extra GPU mem per rank that looks dominated by NCCL / temp comm buffers.
Priya K.: Can you paste the nvprof/nsys snippet? wondering if it's actually NCCL or temporary workspace from cublas
Evan R.: pasted below, truncated. shows repeated cudaMalloc/cudaFree spikes during scatter + allreduce steps.
```
[nsys] cudaMalloc 1048576 bytes @0x7f... (stack)
cudaFree  ...
ncclCommAlloc 524288 bytes
ncclAllReduce start ...
```
Jorge L.: That ncclCommAlloc entry rings a bell — we allocate per-op comm buffers in the runtime currently, not reusing a preallocated pool.
Maya S.: Which allocator? ephemeral allocator or the main device allocator?
Evan R.: Ephemeral. Config has ephemeral_pool_enabled=true but pool size default is tiny: 128MB. Each rank ends up doing repeated small allocations causing fragmentation and OOM headroom loss.
Priya K.: Quick idea: preallocate a shared NCCL comm workspace per-process and hand out slices. Also tune workspace_size_mb for cuBLAS/cuDNN to avoid transient peaks.
Jorge L.: Agree. I prototyped reusing a per-stream comm buffer before — added a ring buffer and it cut comm-related allocations by ~70% in synthetic tests.
Maya S.: Any perf hit from reusing? race conditions on different streams?
Jorge L.: Need per-stream or mutexed freelist. I used one freelist per CUDA stream to avoid sync; no perf regression.
Evan R.: Patch I ran: set allocator.max_cached_bytes=1GB, ephemeral_pool=off, prealloc_comm_pool=768MB. Test results: peak mem down 1.1GB/rank, latency unchanged.
infra-bot: perf-ci/job/3201 finished: membaseline -> nccl-reuse patch. peak_mem: 41.9GB -> 40.0GB, p95_latency: 42ms -> 43ms
Priya K.: p95 up 1ms — likely noise. Any change in KV cache behavior? those shards still need their kv memory.
Evan R.: KV cache unchanged. This is strictly comm/temp/allocator overhead. Also found cuBLAS workspace spikes when sequence length jumps — set CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG to enable deterministic workspace and limit growth.
Maya S.: Can we roll this as a runtime flag? e.g., runtime.conf: {
  "nccl_comm_pool_mb": "768",
  "allocator.max_cached_bytes_mb": "1024",
  "cublas_workspace_limit_mb": "256"
}
Priya K.: thumbs up. Add metrics: nccl_comm_pool_used_mb and allocator_cached_mb so we can verify in prod.
Jorge L.: I'll open a small PR with the freelist + config + perf test. Will also add a flaky test for multi-gpu OOM scenarios.
Evan R.: Thanks. For next round let's run longer tail tests with bursty short requests to exercise allocation churn.
Maya S.: noted — I'll queue up a 24h perf job on the staging fleet and tag you all.
Evan R.: :thumbsup:
